subject: Software Development

assessmentTargets.concept: Git is a distributed version control system that tracks changes across a project.
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: Git is basically a distributed version control system, which will be helping the developers to keep track about whatever changes they are doing in the project that they are developing.
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: Git is basically a distributed version control system, which will be helping the developers to keep track about whatever changes they are doing in the project that they are developing.
assessmentTargets.instruction: Explain the role of a DVCS and why Git qualifies as one.

assessmentTargets.concept: The `git --version` command reports the installed Git version.
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: git version ... will give you whatever the latest version that you have installed.
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: git version ... will give you whatever the latest version that you have installed.
assessmentTargets.instruction: Run the command and state the output format.

assessmentTargets.concept: `git config --global user.name` and `git config --global user.email` set the author information for commits.
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: git config is a command which is used to give details, give your details to the Git tool... you have to give your details like your username, your email ID.
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: git config is a command which is used to give details, give your details to the Git tool... you have to give your details like your username, your email ID.
assessmentTargets.instruction: Configure a name and email, then verify with `git config --list`.

assessmentTargets.concept: `git init` creates an empty local repository ready to track changes.
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: git init ... will tell you that an empty repository has been created.
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: git init ... will tell you that an empty repository has been created.
assessmentTargets.instruction: Initialize a new directory and confirm the presence of the .git folder.

assessmentTargets.concept: `git status` shows modified, staged, and untracked files in the working tree.
assessmentTargets.supportingEvidence: git status ... will tell you what are the changes that you have made and which changes have not yet been saved into the repository.
assessmentTargets.evidenceSpan: git status ... will tell you what are the changes that you have made and which changes have not yet been saved into the repository.
assessmentTargets.instruction: Run `git status` after modifying a file and interpret the output.

diagnosticEntries.concept: Git is a distributed version control system that tracks changes across a project.
The `git --version` command reports the installed Git version.
`git config --global user.name` and `git config --global user.email` set the author information for commits.
`git init` creates an empty local repository ready to track changes.
`git status` shows modified, staged, and untracked files in the working tree.
